name: myproject
description: This example code is bare-bones to show you what this framework can do. If you have the style-dictionary module installed globally, you can `cd` into this directory and run:

scripts.watch: nodemon --watch MyProject/tokens/global.json --exec "npx style-dictionary build && sass MyProject/scss/style.scss MyProject/build/css/style.css && git add . && git commit -m 'chore: Update generated files' && git push"
